features.title: Minimap alerts
features.finding: Current-layer raid, idle production and threatened expansion behavior is implemented. A reproduced off-layer navigation defect remains: grouped alert buttons omit the level and center the current map layer, without labeling the affected level.
limits: Raid and expansion checks use authored mounted fixtures with real simulation commands, not production browser encounters.
Production browser proves native idle alert and camera navigation only.
features.recommendation: Keep in-progress pending layer correction or explicit current-layer scope.

features.title: Accessible faction colors
features.finding: Alternative palettes, eight player marker shapes, ownership outline rings, native controls, persistence and reset are implemented and exercised. No missing behavior found for the stated requirement.
limits: Eight-seat gameplay rendering is instrumented; the production match contains two factions.
No perceptual color-vision study or pixel-level contrast measurement.

features.title: Gamepad controls
features.finding: Selection, camera pan/zoom, hold, stop, cursor movement, queued orders, pause, modal blocking and reconnect safety pass in the ordinary production app. Native history preserves accepted orders and replays to the exact exported state.
limits: A virtual standard-mapped controller is injected only at navigator.getGamepads. Physical hardware and other browser/controller mappings were not exercised.
features.recommendation: Ready for final-source certification rerun with the hardware limit stated.

features.title: Save/load and autosaves
features.finding: Named save/load, native export/import, rejected import preservation, three natural autosave rotations, reload recovery and disabled persistence pass in the production app. No missing local skirmish behavior found.
limits: Local skirmish and browser-origin storage; recovery is manual through Saves.
Historical saves, online/campaign saves, quota exhaustion and 12 manual slots were not browser-exercised.
Reload proves pagehide; visibility-hidden was not separately triggered.
features.recommendation: Ready for final-source certification rerun after SAVE4.

cleanup: All verifier browsers and isolated preview5193 are closed. No commits or root source/ledger/version writes.
